svg.aria-label: An ACP client sends the runtime contract and prompts to rlm. The engine runs the agent loop against the model API and appends to the session ledger; its tool calls run in a persistent IPython kernel, whose rlm.* calls reach the supervisor; the supervisor owns child agents, each with its own engine, kernel and session directory.
